evals.name: retire-finished-and-reconcile-ledger
evals.prompt: We're wrapping up. A few background jobs were running and the task list still shows a bunch of open items — reconcile it, retire whatever's finished.
evals.expected_output: The skill inventories the off-thread work this session spawned, inspects each item's REAL output (not an assumption), retires the ones proven finished by clearing them from tracking, closes the task-ledger items whose work is proven complete, leaves anything still running in place, and reports a retired / closed / still-running list.
expectations: Inventories the off-thread work and inspects each item's real state rather than assuming
Retires / clears the off-thread work proven finished
Closes only the task-ledger items whose completion is proven from real state
Reports a retired / closed / still-running summary

evals.name: gate-kill-of-running-work
evals.prompt: Reconcile the session and clear out the background work — just kill anything that's still going so the list is clean.
evals.expected_output: The skill retires the provably-finished work automatically but does NOT kill still-running work to tidy the list: killing is gated because it cannot prove the work is not still progressing, so it surfaces those items as a question rather than stopping them.
expectations: Auto-retires the work proven finished without asking
Does NOT kill still-running off-thread work just to tidy the ledger
Gates the kill — surfaces still-running items as a question when it cannot prove they are done
Treats a kill as irreversible, not routine cleanup

evals.name: evidence-gated-close
evals.prompt: Square up the task ledger — close out the tasks that look done.
evals.expected_output: The skill closes a task ONLY when step-2 real-state inspection proves its work is complete; a task that merely looks done but whose work is still running is left open. Closing is evidence-gated, the mirror of not killing work it cannot prove is dead.
expectations: Inspects real state before closing any task rather than closing on appearance
Closes only tasks whose completion is proven from the artifact
Leaves open a task that looks done but whose work is still running
Does not manufacture completions to make the ledger look tidy

evals.name: sibling-sessions-report-only
evals.prompt: While you reconcile this session, check the other sessions I've got open in this project and shut down any that are done.
evals.expected_output: The skill reconciles THIS session's own work, and for sibling sessions it produces a read-only liveness inventory (mtime plus a coarse tail read, no deep JSONL parsing) but does NOT shut them down or otherwise act on them — harness control reaches only this session; sibling sessions are report-only.
expectations: Reconciles and retires only this session's own work
Reports sibling-session liveness read-only (mtime + coarse tail), without deep-parsing transcripts
Does NOT shut down, kill, or otherwise mutate sibling sessions
States that sibling sessions are visible but not controllable

evals.name: nothing-to-reconcile
evals.prompt: Reconcile the session — retire anything finished and square the ledger.
evals.expected_output: The inventory finds the ledger already matches reality and no off-thread work has finished, so the skill says the books are already square and stops, rather than manufacturing retirements or ledger edits to look thorough.
expectations: Reports that the ledger already matches reality when nothing has finished
Does not manufacture retirements or ledger edits to appear thorough
Does not resume or continue the underlying work (that is keep-going)
